description: Mock price catalog used by compute_quote for the event-vendor demo. All figures are illustrative for the hackathon and not real market rates — swap for a real pricing sheet in production.

pricing_tiers.note: Applied based on budget_range signal from the brief. 'lean' tier used when budget is stated as tight/limited; 'standard' is default when budget is unspecified or mid-range; 'premium' used when budget signals high-end ('no expense spared', large stated figure).

line_items.label: Canopy / Tent Rental
line_items.applies_when: indoor_outdoor == outdoor OR indoor_outdoor == both OR indoor_outdoor missing
line_items.notes: Priced per block of 50 guests, rounded up. E.g. 120 guests = 3 blocks.

line_items.label: Decor & Styling
line_items.notes: Includes drapes, centerpieces, backdrop, aisle/stage decor as applicable to event_type.

line_items.label: Generator / Power Backup
line_items.notes: If power_backup_needed explicitly false, omit this line item entirely.

line_items.label: Ushers & Event Staff
line_items.notes: One staffing block per 25 guests, rounded up.

line_items.label: Catering
line_items.notes: Omit this line item entirely if catering_included is false or missing — do not assume catering is wanted.

contingencies.label: Transport & Logistics
contingencies.notes: Standard assumption: 8% of subtotal for delivery, setup, and pickup of rented items. In production this would vary by venue distance from the SME's base location — flagged as a simplification for the demo.

contingencies.label: Rush Fee
contingencies.condition: event_date is within 7 days of the quote being generated
contingencies.notes: Applied only if the event date is very close. Should be clearly itemized and explained in the quote message so it doesn't read as a hidden fee.

contingencies.label: Fuel/Fluctuation Buffer
contingencies.notes: Small buffer against fuel/generator running costs and general price volatility, common practice among Nigerian event vendors. Always applied.

quote_terms.default_payment_terms: 50% deposit to confirm booking, balance due 3 days before the event.
quote_terms.notes: validity_period_days and payment_terms are included in the draft_message_to_client generated by compute_quote.
